-- fs --
home/evan/photo.png 52000
home/evan/trip.jpg 40000
home/evan/notes.md 300
home/evan/todo.txt 80
home/evan/sales.csv 900
home/evan/setup.dmg 7000
home/evan/projects/gloss/readme.md 100
home/evan/projects/gloss/logo.png 100
-- script --
option filters kinds
start /home/evan
size 70 14
note nothing is chosen: everything is listed; the chip at the footer's right opens the menu
snapshot closed
state types ""
note Ctrl-F opens the menu of kinds; space checks one
press ctrl+f
snapshot menu
state menu true
press down space
snapshot pictures
state types Pictures
note folders stay, to get to files; only pictures are listed beside them
reject notes.md
expect photo.png
note a second kind widens it
press down down space
state types Pictures,Data
expect sales.csv
reject todo.txt
note the choice holds as you walk into a folder
press esc
state menu false
press enter
state dir /home/evan/projects
press enter
snapshot in-gloss
reject readme.md
expect logo.png
note All types clears them
press ctrl+f
press home space
state types ""
snapshot cleared
expect readme.md
note typing while the menu is open closes it and goes to the filter
press ctrl+f
type lo
state menu false
state filter lo
